channel.description: Latest articles from The Times Gainesville GA (gainesvilletimes.com)

item.title: High school football: Gainesville sets ambitious schedule featuring local and out-of-state powerhouses for 2026
item.description: Games against Buford and Illinois powerhouse East St. Louis highlight a challenging 2026 slate for the Red Elephants.

item.title: High school baseball: Sixth-ranked North Hall earns emotional win against No. 1 Pickens
item.description: Trojans remembering beloved teacher, coach Jason Hughes who died March 6.

item.title: Update: Location changed for protest to shed light on Epstein Files. Here are the details
item.description: A protest has been organized to raise awareness about convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein and to show solidarity with survivors who organizers say were trafficked, raped and tortured.

item.title: 7 ways to celebrate St. Patrick’s Day in Northeast Georgia
item.description: Every year on March 17, the world turns a little greener in honor of St. Patrick’s Day. From parades and pub crawls to cultural festivals and family-friendly events, Northeast Georgia goes all out to mark the occasion.

item.title: Hall County Animal Shelter hosting ‘Kitten Shower’ ahead of kitten season
item.description: As shelters across the nation prepare for an influx of pregnant cats, the Hall County Animal Shelter will be opening their intake center for a morning in support of their tiniest residents.

item.title: Sen. Jon Ossoff helps deliver $1.8 million to Salvation Army of Gainesville
item.description: U.S. Sen. Jon Ossoff has secured $1.8 million in federal funding to help the Salvation Army of Gainesville.

item.title: Update: This Gainesville taqueria that failed its health inspection has passed its follow-up with a 90
item.description: Taqueria Lupita was able to rectify most of the concerns raised since its March 2 score of 57 out of 100.

item.title: These 5 Gainesville City elementary school teams advanced to Odyssey of the Mind State Tournament
item.description: Five elementary teams with the Gainesville City School System have qualified for the Odyssey of the Mind State Tournament, according to a press release.

item.title: Hall County BOC votes to suspend planning commissioners' pay. Here’s why.
item.description: The Hall County Board of Commissioners on Thursday, March 12, voted unanimously to suspend pay for the two remaining planning commissioners while the planning commission is suspended.

item.title: Funeral arrangements set for North Hall High teacher killed in prank gone wrong
item.description: Funeral services have been scheduled for Jason Ryan Hughes, a beloved North Hall High School math teacher, mentor and former golf coach who died over the weekend in a prank gone wrong.
